name: Demo fixture versus source-grounded quadruped
question: Does the Solo12-informed candidate preserve nominal four-foot support and collision-free recovery contact opportunities while replacing the demo fixture with a traceable physical architecture?

candidates.hypothesis: The corrected demo fixture provides the existing static support/contact screen that the modern candidate must not regress.
candidates.falsifiedIf: The authored home lacks four-foot support or any frozen resting pose lacks two collision-free foot contact opportunities.

candidates.hypothesis: A source-grounded 2.5 kg, 12-DoF architecture with realistic link lengths and actuator limits preserves the cheap static mechanisms needed to justify bounded dynamic standing and recovery probes.
candidates.falsifiedIf: The authored home lacks four-foot support, any frozen resting pose lacks two collision-free foot contact opportunities, or the required pose depends on disallowed self-contact.
